app.name: Blinkora Studio
app.tagline: Create your marketing video by chatting

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to your account to start creating videos.
auth.mockNotice: Demo mode: any email and password will work.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.createVideoDesc: Chat with the assistant and get a professional promo video in minutes.
dashboard.noProjects: No videos yet. Create your first one!

chat.placeholder: Describe your video... (Bangla, Banglish or English)
chat.welcomeTitle: 👋 Welcome! What kind of video do you want to make?
chat.welcomeBody: Tell me about your business or product in your own words. You can write in Bangla, Banglish or English — whatever feels natural.

questions.intent: What would you like to promote? Tell me a bit about your business or product.
questions.assets: Now upload a few photos of your product.
questions.style: What feel do you want for the video?
questions.duration: How long should the video be?
questions.platform: Which platform is this video for?
questions.campaign: Is this a general product promo, an Eid campaign, an offer video, or something else?

validation.valid: ✅ This image looks good. The product details are clearly visible.
validation.blurry: ⚠️ This image is a bit blurry. Upload a sharper image for a better result.
validation.lowResolution: ⚠️ This image has low resolution. Upload a higher-resolution version if possible.
validation.cropped: ⚠️ Part of the product looks cut off. A photo with the full product visible will give a better result.
validation.tooDark: ⚠️ This image is a bit dark. A brighter image will preserve the product's colors and details better.
validation.corrupt: ❌ This image couldn't be opened. Please upload a different image file.
validation.unsupported: ❌ This file type isn't supported. Please use JPG, PNG, or WEBP.
